name: Roman Empire The
overview: Scripture, particularly in Daniel 2 and 7, reveals the Roman Empire as a powerful and iron-strong kingdom that breaks and subdues all things, symbolized by iron legs and teeth. This kingdom is characterized by strength mixed with fragility, as seen in the feet partly of iron and partly of clay, indicating a divided and brittle nature despite its might. The empire’s strength is emphasized by its crushing power and its division into ten parts, reflecting both its authority and internal division.
